name: WOMAN IN THE PRISON -Tokushu Kangoku no Onna-
original_name: WOMAN IN THE PRISON -特殊監獄の女-
source:
It was a gloomy time of war.

The world was in chaos.
Criminals were everywhere.
Prisons were already full.

So criminals were forcibly confined to facilities called detention centers. These were special prisons. Hell within massive walls. 

Another female prisoner is confined there . 

What atonement will she face for her blood-stained crimes? 

And what will her fate be? 

Will she be able to face her harsh destiny and return to the free world? 

Or will it be an endless hell? 

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ152175.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
那是一个阴郁的战争年代。

世界陷入混乱，罪犯随处可见，监狱早已人满为患。

于是，罪犯被强行关进称为拘留所的设施里。这些特别监狱宛如高墙围起的人间地狱。

又一名女囚被关押于此。

她将为自己沾满鲜血的罪行付出什么代价？

她的命运又会如何？

她能否面对残酷的命运，重返自由世界？

还是只能永远困在地狱里？
